{{dablink|For other uses of the word "light," see [[Light (disambiguation)|Light]].}}
'''Sky Lights''' are similar to fireworks, only made with the [[One Power]].

==Description==
Originating in [[Seanchan]], Sky Lights are made by ''[[damane]]'' as entertainment.

==Mentions==
Captain [[Assid Bakuun]] laments the fact that the ''damane'' are ill and therefore unable to produce Sky Lights. He thinks that fireworks are a pitiful thing compared to Sky Lights.{{ref/book|8|22}} [[Matrim Cauthon]] tells [[Aludra]] that ''damane'' can make Sky Lights and that they make fireworks "look like a few sparks flying up the chimney." Aludra has not seen them and continues to create fireworks.{{ref/book|9|15}}
